desc: Bright compact bakery & ice cream parlour also featuring desserts & cakes in a cheerful ambience.
addr: 884, 5th Main Rd, opposite Garden City University, Binnamangala, Stage 1, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India

rev.t: Visited Ibaco recently and absolutely loved the experience! The variety of flavours is impressive, and each one tastes rich and fresh. The toppings are generous, and the ability to customise your scoop makes it even better. The ambience is clean and welcoming, and the service is quick. A perfect spot to satisfy your ice-cream cravings!

I Regularly visit Ibaco, and it’s honestly my favourite place to just sit, relax, and enjoy some amazing ice cream. 🤍
What I love most is the concept — choosing your flavours and toppings exactly …
Has a good park nearby and easy to find parking. As always excellent ice cream and friendly staff..
